policy: Original local evidence retained. Projected text replaces host filesystem paths with role tokens; projected JSON is reserialized with standard Unicode escapes. Semantic numeric values, errors and scene identities remain unchanged except declared path substitutions; all original PNG bytes retained. Archive/member and compressed/uncompressed hashes distinguish layers. Never substitute projected hash for original evidence identity.
